newsitem.title: USA: Executone sets 1-for-3 reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: Executone sets 1-for-3 reverse stock split.

text.p: Executone Information Systems Inc said on Thursday that its board approved a reverse one-for-three stock split.
Shareholders are scheduled to vote at the company's annual meeting on May 27, 1997.

The board has also approved a $10 million, two-year stock repurchase program. However, the execution of the program is dependent on the price of Executone's stock and prevailing market conditions over that 2-year period.

The company also reported that it completed the repurchase of 700,000 shares of stock in December, and an additional 1.8 million shares of stock in January 1997 in two private transactions at an average purchase price of $2.63 per share.
